name: compact-session-footer
description: inline composer controls stay on one row and compress status facts in priority order, in both the expanded card and the folded one-line shape - which holds at every card width, dropping the effort readout below the row threshold and yielding the field floor at the narrowest cards

mutation.declaration: Nine manual probes against fresh production CSS: (1) statusrow .context { order: 2 }; (2) 479/559 max-width and 560 min-width query boundaries shifted +20px; (3) composer .leading flex changed to 0 1 auto and promptcard .actions margin-left changed to 0; (4) composer/session/status min-width:0 changed to max-content and overflow:hidden changed to visible; (5) Button outline plus model/effort/session-actions inset focus shadows removed; (6) model trigger width:100% plus model wrapper flex:1 1 72px; (7) statusrow .identity > span:not([data-effort-control]):not(.context) reverted to :not([data-effort-control]) (dropping :not(.context)); (8) statusrow's folded effort-drop query `(width < 620px)` moved to `(width < 1px)`; (9) promptcard's folded field-yield threshold 420px moved to 1px
mutation.expect: Each probe exits 1 with, respectively: context-to-model order failure; 480/560 visibility failures; Send trailing-edge failure; scroll-width/containment failures; all five focus-ring failures; model shrink-to-fit failure; context wrapper shrink and ring clip failure at 320px; six effort-readout-should-be-hidden failures across the sub-620px folded fixtures; 320px-folded scroll-width, escape/clip and order failures with the 224px floor unyielded
mutation.note: 2026-11-25: probe (1) failed across all 12 fixtures with context-to-model order failure; probe (7) failed at 320px with context wrapper shrinking to 11.0x14.0px and clipping the 14.0x14.0px ring. Probes (2)-(6) reflect the 2026-08-10 baseline (with 400px bar-swap removed). 2026-11-27: probe (8) failed six effort-dropped fixtures (619.5/560/480/419.5/420.5/320) with 'effort readout should be hidden, got display:flex'; probe (9) failed the 320px-folded fixture with overflow, clip and order failures. The unconditional folded row shape is evidenced by the same case's pre-fix red run: on 2026-11-25-era CSS every sub-620px folded fixture stacked to a two-line card (field off the control row, effort visible where the ladder drops it).
